scope: How Todoist assigns, reschedules, and surfaces due dates — NLP capture, recurrence, duration, deadlines (Pro), and Today/Upcoming views. Single-competitor run; no logged-in UI capture on this environment.

capabilities.name: Date-only assignment
capabilities.todoist: Yes — task view Date field or Quick Add NLP

capabilities.name: Date + time
capabilities.todoist: Yes — NLP or scheduler time picker

capabilities.name: Recurring due dates
capabilities.todoist: Yes — NLP recurrence with completion-based next occurrence

capabilities.name: Task duration
capabilities.todoist: Yes — for Xh/Xm; max 24h; requires date+time

capabilities.name: Start dates / hide until start
capabilities.todoist: No — tasks remain visible in projects

bullets: Dual model: scheduled date vs hard deadline
Quick Add is the primary capture surface for dates and recurrence
Recurring completion semantics can shift next due if completed after midnight
Duration requires time; 24h cap; no multi-day duration span
Deep scheduling controls in task view right sidebar on web/desktop

loginFailures: CloakBrowser binary unavailable on macOS (linux-x64 only)
planGated: Calendar layout for durations — documented Pro/Business
assumptions: Overdue UI treatment not verified in logged-in app
Findings primarily from Todoist Help Center articles
